info.description: The Loyalty Balance Retrieval API allows consumers to access and view the loyalty balance of customers. This endpoint facilitates quick retrieval of loyalty points, which can be leveraged by customer service representatives and applications to enhance customer engagement and satisfaction. By querying this API, businesses can provide real-time updates to customers about their loyalty status and rewards. Ideal for integration in mobile apps and web interfaces, this API supports improving customer loyalty initiatives through transparent balance information.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to access the current loyalty balance of a user, providing insights into points or rewards accumulated. It is essential for applications that offer loyalty rewards programs.

requestBody.description: This request is used to retrieve the current balance of the user's loyalty account. The request body should be structured according to the specified schema for proper processing.
